files.tests/test_dashboard.py:
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest

from app import data

APP = "app/streamlit_app.py"


def start(**query):
    at = AppTest.from_file(APP, default_timeout=30)
    for key, value in query.items():
        at.query_params[key] = value
    return at.run()


def test_data_helpers():
    rows = data.make_sales()
    assert data.regions(rows) == ["East", "North", "South"]
    north = data.filter_sales(rows, "North", 100)
    assert data.totals_by_region(north) == [{"region": "North", "total": 380.0}]


def test_default_view():
    at = start()
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.title[0].value == "Sales dashboard"
    assert at.selectbox[0].value == "All"
    assert [m.value for m in at.metric] == ["8", "1385.5"]
    assert at.caption[0].value.startswith("visits: ")


def test_region_from_link():
    at = start(region="North")
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.selectbox[0].value == "North"
    assert [m.value for m in at.metric] == ["3", "420.0"]


def test_minimum_amount_filter():
    at = start()
    at.slider[0].set_value(200).run()
    assert [m.value for m in at.metric] == ["4", "1110.0"]


def test_share_view_updates_link():
    at = start()
    at.selectbox[0].set_value("South").run()
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.query_params["region"] in ("South", ["South"])
    assert [m.value for m in at.metric] == ["3", "645.5"]

    assert any(c.value.startswith("api key: ") for c in at.caption)

change.behaviour: With no secrets.toml, `"KEY" in st.secrets` raises FileNotFoundError ('No secrets files found...') on 1.28.2 and StreamlitSecretNotFoundError (a FileNotFoundError subclass, another message) on 1.67.0. The app catches FileNotFoundError, so the caption reads 'api key: none (FileNotFoundError)' vs 'none (StreamlitSecretNotFoundError)'; the test only checks the prefix. Depends on the host having no ~/.streamlit/secrets.toml.

notes: Streamlit 1.28.2 on 3.11 (the first releases with streamlit.testing.v1.AppTest; numpy 1.26.4, pandas 2.1.4, pyarrow 14.0.2, altair 5.1.2 pinned as a 2023 lock file would) -> 1.67.0 on 3.12 (pulls pandas 3, numpy 2, pyarrow 26). The app keeps its data in plain lists of dicts so pandas 2 -> 3 does not leak into the comparison; streamlit converts them internally for st.table. Tests drive the script with AppTest (the script runs in a ScriptRunner thread, by exec of its compiled code), plus one plain-function test. Old side emits NO Python warning for any of the removed APIs: Streamlit reports its deprecations as st.warning elements inside the app and as log lines (st.cache, experimental_memo/singleton, experimental_rerun), so expected_warnings is empty; the only Python warnings are 'invalid escape sequence' DeprecationWarnings from compiling streamlit's own docstrings. New side: every removed st.* name raises AttributeError from streamlit's module __getattr__ with a message that names the successor. experimental_rerun is guarded by session_state (one rerun on the first run): AppTest 1.28 recurses forever when a clicked button reruns. AppTest itself changed: relative script paths now resolve against the calling test file (a test-code break), and AppTest.query_params values are str instead of lists (the test accepts both). The change scenario depends on the host having no ~/.streamlit/secrets.toml.
